model: RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn, n_estimators=500, random_state=42), trained on 80% stratified split of data.csv
notes: Stratified 80/20 split (seed 42); no preprocessing, so zero-valued measurements (e.g. insulin, skin_thickness) were kept as-is. The data has 57 exact duplicate rows that were not removed, so test accuracy may be slightly optimistic.
